reason: I already have unit tests, end-to-end tests and CI catching regressions, and recording scenarios then checking AI-written business rules sounds like a second test suite to babysit. Free doesn't help much when the real cost is my time in the middle of a migration I've already put off for a year.
objection: I don't trust an AI to infer the business rules correctly, and a field-by-field diff between old and new will flag a pile of intentional changes and noise that I then have to triage by hand.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it catch a real regression on a migration like mine that our existing test suite missed, with setup taking under an hour.
